Greetings evening team,
The cargo liaison sent an update on quiet corners. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is in a good place tonight, and I want everyone to keep the same steady pace on intake, handoff, and release. Please keep carrier checks calm and consistent, make sure water bowls are refreshed when needed, and keep notes clear so the next shift can pick up without any guesswork. When a family arrives tired or worried, a few extra minutes of patient reassurance go a long way.

For the lounge and screening flow, keep the path open and avoid crowding around the holding area. <<FACT F021>> Please route all follow-up care through the standard desk channel, and keep an eye on pets that seem stressed by noise or movement. If a carrier label looks unclear, slow down and verify it before anything moves. The ground team is doing well with careful transfers, so let us keep that rhythm steady and gentle.

One more note for the team on the night side: <<FACT F012>> That should help us keep the lane balanced while still giving each animal the attention it deserves. If you see a traveler arrive with a nervous pet, use the quiet corner first and bring in support early rather than waiting for a small issue to grow. We are doing solid work for Aurelia Skyways, and the calm handling everyone brings to the Companion Animal Travel Desk makes a real difference for the pets and their people. Keep it smooth, keep it kind, and let the handoffs stay relaxed.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
